changelog: v1.0.11: module permission card. The page now shows the three switches that decide what it can do — access mode, Allow background actions, trust — read from getModuleInfo(), with the one state users keep missing called out in amber: background off means the boot-time auto-recovery (service.sh) never runs. New 「打开模块设置」 button jumps straight to the manager's module settings when the manager supports window.Shizuku.openSettings() (Shizuku-Next PR #178); on managers without it the button hides and the manual path is spelled out. Also notes how to stop the per-command 「运行此命令?」 review: long-press the module card → 信任. v1.0.10: MCS long-connection ground truth. The status page now probes directly for an ESTABLISHED TCP connection to mtalk.google.com:5228 (the Google push endpoint, read from /proc/net/tcp) — if the link is up, the verdict is healthy regardless of which process holds it; if it is down while everything else checks out, the banner says so in plain words: 「推送长连接未建立 —— 缺网络，不是设备问题」, naming the fix (proxy the GMS traffic: per-app mode → add Google Play 服务 to the proxy list; TUN/global → verify the proxy itself works). This closes the loop on the most common CN failure: GFW blocks 5228, no amount of heartbeats can raise the link without a proxy. New status row 「推送长连接 (mtalk:5228)」; old reports show 未知(旧报告). v1.0.9: verdict-first status page with big color-coded conclusion banners. v1.0.8: push-backbone probe (persistent process, not the on-demand GcmService). v1.0.7: self-healing targets + [diag] truth lines (toybox grep \s root cause fixed). v1.0.6: probe-truth hardening. v1.0.5: one-tap log copy. v1.0.4: friendly guidance UX. v1.0.3: dead-bridge read-only mode. v1.0.2: universal bridge adapter. v1.0.1: absolute moduleDir paths. v1.0.0: initial release. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
